answer: The architecture features a single API surface acting as a Model Router (port 8000) that directs client requests to one of two co-resident model backends. The router selects the optimized backend based on the request.model parameter. The two model backends are Qwen 3.6 27B (port 8867) and Gemma 4 31B (port 8868). Clients interact via a single endpoint using OpenAI-compatible calls for text, vision, and tool use.
